purpose: Commissioning run of SDK v1.0.3 on a community contributor's Linux workstation: end-to-end salmon orchestration through the public CLI on one real paired-end sample, plus structural parity of the emitted quant.sf against a legacy quant directory. Single cold-cache run; not a speedup comparison.

methodology.warmup: none; cold cache first run on this host
methodology.disclosure: single cold-cache commissioning run; do not compare against warm-cache repeats
